title: Identify public high schools in the county with the most closed schools tha
question: Identify public high schools in the county with the most closed schools that have a free meal eligibility rate (K-12) above 10% and rank among the top 3 by latitude within that county. Return the school name, full street address, phone number, and latitude.

prediction.sql:
WITH closed_counts AS (
  SELECT s.XCL_045 AS county, COUNT(*) AS closed_count
  FROM schools s
  WHERE s.XCL_044 = 'Closed'
  GROUP BY s.XCL_045
),
target_county AS (
  SELECT county FROM closed_counts ORDER BY closed_count DESC LIMIT 1
),
qualified AS (
  SELECT s.XCL_047 AS school_name,
         s.XCL_048 AS full_street_address,
         s.XCL_058 AS phone_number,
         s.XCL_078 AS latitude
  FROM schools s
  INNER JOIN frpm f ON s.XCL_041 = f.XCL_001
  WHERE s.XCL_069 = 'High Schools (Public)'
    AND s.XCL_045 = (SELECT county FROM target_county)
    AND CAST(f.XCL_020 AS REAL) / f.XCL_019 > 0.10
)
SELECT school_name, full_street_address, phone_number, latitude
FROM qualified
ORDER BY latitude DESC
LIMIT 3

WITH closed_counts AS (
  SELECT s.XCL_045 AS county, COUNT(*) AS closed_count
  FROM schools s
  WHERE s.XCL_044 = 'Closed'
  GROUP BY s.XCL_045
),
target_county AS (
  SELECT county FROM closed_counts ORDER BY closed_count DESC LIMIT 1
),
qualified AS (
  SELECT s.XCL_047 AS school_name,
         s.XCL_048 AS full_street_address,
         s.XCL_058 AS phone_number,
         s.XCL_078 AS latitude
  FROM schools s
  INNER JOIN frpm f ON s.XCL_041 = f.XCL_001
  WHERE s.XCL_069 = 'High Schools (Public)'
    AND s.XCL_045 = (SELECT county FROM target_county)
    AND CAST(f.XCL_020 AS REAL) / f.XCL_019 > 0.10
)
SELECT school_name, full_street_address, phone_number, latitude
FROM qualified
ORDER BY latitude DESC
LIMIT 3
